svg.aria-label: Eight repos into one. Main backend engineer on the telemedicine platform: onboarding, ID checks, triage, encounters, Stripe and DoseSpot e-prescribing. Consolidated eight service repos into one monorepo with twelve packages and CI, then ported it to launch StatWell, a sister brand.
